newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end soft, electricity stocks slide.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end soft, electricity stocks slide.

text.p: Chilean stocks closed sharply lower on Monday after the government's announcement of measures to damp power demand set back electricity share prices, traders said.
The measures are intended to help generators that have suffered sharp cuts in electricity output from their dams as a result of a drought this year.
"The rationing has taken people by surprise. Investors hadn't realized we had got to this stage," said David Hurd, head of research at Merrill Lynch.
The index closed down 0.99 percent at 117.15.
The general index lost 0.68 percent at 5,340.54 points on turnover of 12.8 billion pesos.
The negative tilt is seen extending into Tuesday, with the electricity sector expected to remain vulnerable, dealers said.
Traders said stocks were partly undermined on Monday by a wave of profit-taking after a vigorous rally last week in anticipation of the central bank's interest rate cut Friday.
Electricity shares also suffered amid concerns over liabilities power generators might face if they could not fulfill contractual obligations to distributors, they said.
